message.content: {"candidate_id": "pair_758dc3dc309ce5ca", "label": "complementary", "right_from_left": null, "rationale": "The predicates `owned_by` and `has` describe different relationships between entities. `owned_by` indicates ownership (a person or entity possesses an item), while `has` indicates possession (an entity holds an item).
